name: artisyn-work-hub
description: Artisyn AI Work Hub: orchestration scripts and test dependencies (server is Rust, web is bun)
author: Denis Tsyplakov

scripts.build:web: cd web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cd web && bun run lint && cd .. && node scripts/agent-names-check.mjs && node scripts/license-check.mjs
scripts.test:algo: cargo test --lib --bins --test algo && cd web && bun run test
scripts.start: npm run build:web && cargo run --release -p work-hub-server
